watch.summary: The creator reacts with disbelief and hilarity to footage of a humanoid robot performing Cristiano Ronaldo's iconic 'Siu' celebration.

beats.what: Creator expresses shock that a robot is doing Ronaldo's celebration.
Creator points out the robot scored a mediocre free kick before celebrating.
Footage shows the robot running and hitting the iconic Siu jump and pose.
Creator bursts into laughter and jokes about Ronaldo being the GOAT.

watch.author: mixed
watch.key_line: Not the robot freaking doing the Ronaldo sui!
watch.why: The visual spectacle of a real humanoid robot pulling off Ronaldo's famous celebration is inherently hilarious and absurd. The creator's genuine disbelief and infectious laughter sell the moment perfectly to anyone scrolling.
